---
name: Wordpress Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for the Wordpress application
title: '[WORDPRESS FEATURE] '
labels: wordpress, enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the Wordpress feature you would like to see.

## Problem or Use Case

What problem does this feature solve? What use case does it address?

**Example:**
"As a [community admin/citizen/moderator], I want to [do something] so that [benefit achieved]."

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working. Be as detailed as possible:

- What would the Wordpress interface or page look like?
- How would users interact with this feature?
- What plugins, themes, or roles would be involved?
- What should integrate with Munibase, if anything?

## Alternative Solutions

Have you considered any alternative approaches or workarounds?

## Benefits

Who would benefit from this feature?

- [ ] Community administrators
- [ ] Community moderators
- [ ] Citizens/members
- [ ] Developers/technical staff
- [ ] All users

## Priority

How important is this feature to your community?

- [ ] Critical - Needed for basic operations
- [ ] High - Would significantly improve experience
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have enhancement
- [ ] Low - Future consideration

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.
